reasoning: A shield with a checkmark is the universal emblem for security, protection, antivirus/privacy checkups, insurance policies, and warranties. It fits a solid set of personal and work tasks around digital security and insurance coverage, though it shares conceptual territory with padlock and plain shield icons.
